summary: Resets the global container/list object at byte_8AC494 and returns a pointer to it. Writes 0 into the seven consecutive dwords from byte_8AC494 through unk_8AC4A8 and writes the literal 1120403456 into unk_8AC4AC. The first dword write zeroes the container head pointer stored at byte_8AC494, and the returned pointer is the object's base. Sister function 004C7C90 destroys the same object via ListDestructorWithSubFree, so byte_8AC494 is a container the caller resets and later frees.

local_names.result: base pointer to the container object at byte_8AC494 returned to the caller
